digest.component_or_area: LLM model selection and fallback routing
propositions: A class with no fallback array should build an unwrapped model, preserving today's behavior
A class with a fallback array should build a FallbackModel whose default is the primary and fallbacks are the remaining entries
An error classified as RETRY_NOW or WAIT_AND_RETRY or CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL should trigger failover to the next candidate in the chain
An error classified as CHANGE_SETTINGS, CHANGE_INPUT, or INCREASE_PROVIDER_LIMITS should propagate without failover

Capabilities are computed as the conservative intersection across all candidates (primary and fallbacks) before the FallbackModel wrapper is constructed, so a missing capability in any candidate withdraws it from the entire chain
The provider_provenance must record both the ordered candidate list and the ran_model from ModelResponse to correctly attest which model actually produced the response
